name: Miner's Fortune
objectiveText: Retrieve the Cats Eye Emerald from one of the Venture Co. Overseers or Enforcers for Wharfmaster Dizzywig at Ratchet. Cats Eye Emerald  ( 1 )

comments.body:
The mine entrance is at 60, 3 in the far Northeast corner of the Barrens. The Enforcers and Overseers are in the mine, but also all around the area outside the mine.

Only had to kill half a dozen of them or so before the emerald dropped.

The reward is some money as well as a 6 slot bag.
replies: Make sure you have completed The Samophlange series quests: (https://www.wowhead.com/forever/search=samophlange#z0zc) up to Samophlange Manual (https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=3924) before you start to wipe out the Venture Co. employees for the Emerald... :-)

comments.body: Let me stress (for I even was stupid enough) that the emerlad can be found at [b]Boulder Lode Mine[/b] and [b]NOT Sludge Fen[/b]. Boulder Lode Mine can be found [b]North East[/b] of Sludge Fen!

In Durotar, head to 61,5. Simple as that. Kill the Overseers in that area. Yes, it can take forever to get the Gem but it [i]will[/i] drop. I got it five minutes into killing the Overseers. I got it from the Overseer on the stairs of the first big building on the right when you arrive at 61,5.

Don't listen to those who say you can only get it from such and such enemy--it drops from any Overseer. Stick near the entrance if you don't want to wander far into the area.
